cells.B: I recently moved from out of country, how can I obtain a License?
cells.C: Are you classified as an Immigrant or Non-Immigrant
cells.D: Immigrant = we will need your Permanent Residence Card, Social Security Card/Number, Proof of Address Documents. You will then need to Complete All required Testing at your local DMV Office
cells.E: I-551 Permanent Resident Card, or an I-551 Stamp on Passport or on I-94

cells.D: Non-Immigrant = Proof of Legal Status( Work Authorization Card) or I-94 issued by DHS or USCIS, Proof of Social Security Card/Number (if Applicable), Proof of Address. You will need to complete All required Testing at your local DMV Office.
cells.E: Valid employment authorization card issued by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) form I-688B or I-766;

cells.B: I Already have a License from my country, Do I need to take a Driving Test?
cells.D: Your Out of Country License will allow you to waive a Drug and Alcohol Test but will require you to complete a Class E General Knowledge and Skills exam at your Local DMV office or Approved FLHSMV 3rd Party Course provider.
If you previously held a Valid US Driver's License, and can provided physical proof or proof of a Driver's Record and we verify with NLETS, no testing will be required

cells.B: I am from out of country and visiting for a short while, am I able to get a License/ID?
cells.D: Valid Passport, DHS form I-94 with required, Proof of Address Documents
You must have proof of Legal entry or status in order to receive a FL Credential.

cells.B: I am a Canadian Citizen, can I get a FL License?
cells.D: Canadians Renewing, replacing or applying for a new driver's license or ID Card in person MUST submit all Real ID compliant documents. Surrender Canadian License for all Exam Reciprocation, or complete Class E Knowledge and Skills Exam at Local DMV, or approved FLHSMV 3rd Party Course Provider.
cells.E: Canadian Passport, Proof of Social Security Number (if Applicable), Proof of Address Documents, Canadian DL

cells.D: If you are unable to provide Real ID Documents for issuance, or proof of legal status.

cells.B: I have a Commercial Driver's License from my country, Can I Obtain a CDL in FL?
cells.D: If you are a US Permanent Resident or US Citizen, you must establish Florida Residency and complete ALL CDL Knowledge and CDL Skills Exams to obtain a FL CDL.
If you do not hold US Permanent Resident or US Citizenship, you are unable to apply for a US CDL per USA DOT.
